title: ConceptCorpus
description: The concept corpus is the canonical store of behavioral-finance concepts the channel covers. Each entry is one concept. Seeded entries are operator-curated; externally-promoted entries are added by the ingestion fact-check agent.

concepts.description: Map of concept_id → ConceptEntry. concept_id is a slug.

canonical_name.description: The canonical display name. Example: 'Loss Aversion'.

alternate_names.description: Other names this concept goes by. Used by ingestion match step.

definition.description: One-sentence definition, 15-30 words. Used as ground truth for definitional claims in fact-check.

canonical_source.description: Origin citation. Null for folk concepts (e.g., 'lifestyle creep').

scenarios.description: Recognizable real-world scenarios that demonstrate the concept. Editor draws from these to write hooks and bodies. 2-5 entries.

mechanism.description: 1-2 sentence explanation of why the bias happens psychologically. Used in the 'reveal' beat.

visual_concepts.description: Search vocabulary for visual asset acquisition. Example: ['shopping cart', 'gym membership card', 'unused subscription'].

format_used.description: Formats this concept has already been published in. Editor avoids re-using same format until 90-day cooldown.

provenance.description: Who put this entry in the corpus. Seeded = operator hand-curated. External_promoted = ingestion fact-check approved.

provisional.description: True for new external_promoted entries until first artifact succeeds review. Cleared on first thumbs-up.

quarantined.description: True if 2-strike threshold reached on artifact rejections. Excluded from selection.

strikes.description: Rejection count for external_promoted entries. Reset on thumbs-up.

source_candidate_id.description: For external_promoted entries: the Candidate.id that triggered promotion.
